newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiei, Nichiei Finance shares ask-only.
newsitem.headline: Nichiei, Nichiei Finance shares ask-only.

text.p: Shares in major lumber dealer Nichiei Co Ltd and its unit Nichiei Finance Co were ask-only on Wednesday morning after the shares were suspended on Tuesday, brokers said.
As of 0025 GMT, Nichiei Co was ask only at 380 yen. It closed at 390 yen on Monday. Nichiei Finance was ask only at 190 yen after settling at 200 yen on Monday.
The two firm's shares were suspended on Tuesday after Nichiei Finance said it would file for protection from creditors and work out a restructuring plan under court guidance.
Tokyo Stock Exchange said on Tuesday that Nichiei Finance, a credit guarantee and financing company, would be delisted next January 23.
